content: Windows supervision of a uvicorn FastAPI service without Docker: NSSM (Non-Sucking Service Manager) is the community-standard true-service wrapper - session-independent auto-start, crash auto-restart, stdout/stderr file logging w/ rotation, per-service env; register python.exe -m uvicorn + set AppDirectory. Windows Task Scheduler (already the gogo convention via install_scheduled_task.ps1 w/ RestartCount) can auto-start at boot/logon and restart on failure exit codes but lacks true service semantics and continuous crash recovery; adequate for single-user desktop. pywin32 win32serviceutil is more code to maintain. Single uvicorn process under the supervisor; avoid --workers.
